tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel and card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and the main workspace sheet.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Search fields, segmented-tab tracks, quiet chips and icon-button fills on `surface`.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The dark app frame: top bar, dock and the outer shell around the workspace.

tokens.name: on-frame
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `frame`.

tokens.name: on-frame-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and idle nav icons on `frame` (7:1+).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, numbers and body copy on `surface`, `canvas`, `surface-sunken` and every tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, meta lines and labels on `surface` and `canvas` (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text and the quietest meta; 4.5:1 on surface and surface-sunken in both themes, still clearly lighter than ink-muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and table rules; decorative, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed placeholder tiles and input borders (3:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active filter chip, confirm actions. Halo's accent is ink, not a hue.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Info tint: stat tiles, event cards, the 'scheduled' state. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Icons and labels on `sky` or as an icon colour on `surface`.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Success tint: published/live states, positive stat tiles. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: mint-ink
tokens.usage: Icons and labels on `mint`; success marks on `surface`.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Highlight tint: the one featured card in a grid, lesson events. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: lilac-ink
tokens.usage: Icons and labels on `lilac`.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Money and attention tint: revenue tiles, task events, pending states. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: butter-ink
tokens.usage: Icons and labels on `butter`.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Danger and support tint: errors, tickets, destructive confirms. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: blush-ink
tokens.usage: Icons and labels on `blush`; destructive text on `surface`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element (3:1+ on `surface`, `canvas` and every tint).

tokens.name: count
tokens.usage: Count pills on nav items and tabs (unread, open approvals).

tokens.name: on-count
tokens.usage: Text on `count`.

tokens.name: on-frame-success
tokens.usage: Success marks on frame: the brand dot, ok lines in logs.

tokens.name: on-frame-danger
tokens.usage: Error lines in logs and other danger marks on frame.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind drawers.

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the command palette.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status ok: done, online, valid (dot). Alias of `mint-ink`.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind ok. Alias of `mint`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Status running: working, syncing (pulsing dot). Alias of `sky-ink`.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind info. Alias of `sky`.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status warn: paused, expiring (triangle). Alias of `butter-ink`.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn. Alias of `butter`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status danger: failed, offline (square). Alias of `blush-ink`.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger. Alias of `blush`.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Status signal: waits for a human (diamond). The only state that may draw attention unasked. Alias of `lilac-ink`.

tokens.name: signal-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind signal, e.g. the approval header. Alias of `lilac`.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Status idle: ready, inactive (ring). Alias of `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added lines. Alias of `mint-ink`.

tokens.name: diff-add-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of added lines. Alias of `mint`.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Removed lines. Alias of `blush-ink`.

tokens.name: diff-del-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of removed lines. Alias of `blush`.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Document previews (invoices, PDFs, mails) stay white in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `paper`.

tokens.name: frame-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on the dark frame (top bar, dock, code blocks). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: frame-active
tokens.usage: Active or selected fill on the dark frame. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: frame-strong
tokens.usage: Strong fill or divider on the dark frame. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-frame-strong
tokens.usage: Highlighted text on the frame (log highlights). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-frame-warn
tokens.usage: Warnings and numbers in logs and code on the frame. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-frame-signal
tokens.usage: Keywords in code on the frame. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on tinted surfaces such as alerts. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Thin outline around swatches and colour wells. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: media-scrim
tokens.usage: Labels and counters on top of photos. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: media-ink
tokens.usage: Text and lines on top of photos. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: media-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow behind lines drawn on photos. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: lightbox
tokens.usage: Full-screen image viewer background. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: lightbox-ink
tokens.usage: Captions in the image viewer. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `paper`. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-subtle
tokens.usage: Small print on `paper`. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: serp-ink
tokens.usage: Search ad preview: text. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: serp-muted
tokens.usage: Search ad preview: description and URL. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: serp-link
tokens.usage: Search ad preview: headline link. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: serp-chip
tokens.usage: Search ad preview: favicon chip. Same in both themes.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: an empty state or a welcome header.

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: The value in a stat tile.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title, top-left of the workspace sheet.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles; wrap to two lines, never truncate to one.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Everything waiting on a decision today.

styles.name: body-long
styles.sample: Hi Mara, we are growing faster than planned.
styles.usage: Reading text: mail bodies, chat messages, notes.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card descriptions and meta lines, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, hints, timestamps and table secondary text, in ink-muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Only for counts inside nav dots and tiny badges.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Logs, DNS records, IDs and code, in font-mono.

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked lines inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards; compact tile inset; row and cell padding; control padding-x.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel inset; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Workspace sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Outer margin of the app frame on large screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs inside cards, table row hovers, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Stat tiles, event cards, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Content cards and side panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The workspace sheet and the app frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, tabs, search, icon buttons and the dock.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on `canvas`.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered card, open menu.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating dock, toasts, menus and modals.

duration.note: Motion timing. Every animation in Halo uses one of these; all motion is switched off under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Press, hover colour changes, chip toggles.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Tab indicator slide, menu open, card lift.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: Entrance of cards, tiles, panels and rows.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Number count-up, chart bars growing, lines drawing, progress fills.

tokens.name: stagger-step
tokens.usage: Delay added per item in a staggered entrance (cards, rows, bars).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances, count-ups and draw-ins: fast start, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Small playful overshoot: dock, toast, modal, badge pop.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things that move between two resting places: tab indicator, switch knob.
